description: This file provides utility functions to estimate the size of a base64-encoded video segment from a byte size and to resolve the maximum allowed size in base64 encoding based on a maximum byte limit. It appears to be part of a media processing or video handling component within the project.

methods.name: export function estimateBase64Size(bytes: number): number { estimateBase64Size
methods.description: Calculates the size of a base64-encoded string given the original byte size, using the formula ceil(bytes / 3) * 4.

methods.name: export function resolveVideoMaxBase64Bytes(maxBytes: number): number { resolveVideoMaxBase64Bytes
methods.description: Determines the maximum size in base64 encoding for a video given a byte limit, constrained by a default maximum size.
